points.why: It names shifting the burden to the intervenor, describes the team's hand-reconciliation skill fading, and treats the outage as how the hidden dependency came to light.
It says a backup vendor covers availability but not the lost capability, yet never says a backup could deepen that loss.

It recommends hand reconciliations each quarter compared against the tool, senior staff training the new hires, and a recovery-time target that tests whether the team can still close without the tool.
It keeps the tool with fixed-rate sampling and puts the vendor dependency on the risk register with a recovery target.

pitfalls.why: It keeps using the tool and adds checks around it.
It calls the backup vendor half the lesson and makes it conditional on the manual fallback target.
